content.comment_body: I also need to synchronize the time and date between a [product_name] Basic Panel and a [product_name] [article_no]. I tried searching the forum for a solution but haven't found anything. Is there any way to address this issue?

Hello [user_name], It's not possible to sync the time between a [product_name] Basic Panel and a [product_name] [article_no]. The [article_no] doesn't make its time available to read from the panel or any other device. Apologies, but that's how the system works. Time synchronization is supported on more advanced controllers like [product_name] [version_no] or higher. Best regards, [user_name]

Thank you for the answer. If, in the future, both the panel and the [product_name] are connected to a SCADA system (such as [product_name]), would it be possible to synchronize the date and time using that setup?

Hello [user_name], First, it's important to note that [product_name] can only connect to one HMI system on the network at a time. So you can either communicate with the basic panel or with [product_name] SCADA, but not both simultaneously. The basic panel receives date and time via an area pointer. Neither [product_name] SCADA nor [product_name] can provide date and time in this manner. Therefore, synchronizing time within your network isn't possible unless you use a CPU that makes date and time accessible for the HMI system. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unable to synchronize time and date between their HMI panel and controller due to limitations in the controller, which doesn't provide system time externally. Attempts to use SCADA solutions are also restricted by network limitations and device compatibility. The lack of time synchronization affects consistency and coordination, especially when more advanced controllers or multiple HMIs are involved.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope to be able to synchronize date and time between the basic panel and controller, preferring an easy integration or a workaround using SCADA software.
